title: iberis linifolia subsp. dunalii
intro: Iberis linifolia subsp. dunalii, commonly known as Dwarf Candytuft or Rock Candytuft, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, fighting against bacterial and fungal infections, and providing relief from digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Iberis linifolia subsp. dunalii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds. However, more research is needed to fully understand its potential therapeutic effects and confirm its uses in traditional medicine.
